_comment: Per-package license overrides for components whose NuGet metadata carries a
license *file* or a legacy `licenseUrl` instead of an SPDX expression, so the
CycloneDX SBOM has no SPDX id to check.
Each entry pins an exact name + version (a version bump must be re-verified),
names the license actually found, and links the evidence that was read. The
substituted license must itself appear in scripts/licenses-allowed.json --
an override records what a package *is*, it never grants an exemption.
Review these like code: the evidence URL is the whole point.

overrides.name: xunit.abstractions
overrides.reason: Package predates SPDX metadata on nuget.org: its nuspec has only <licenseUrl>https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xunit/xunit/master/license.txt</licenseUrl>, so the SBOM records the license as name 'Unknown - See URL'. It is built from the xunit/xunit repository, which is Apache-2.0 -- the same license every other xunit.* package in this solution declares as an SPDX id.
